title: Malliavin calculus and densities for chaos-driven stochastic differential equations
summary: We study stochastic differential equations driven by finite-order chaos processes on abstract Wiener spaces, with pathwise Riemann-Stieltjes integration. The driving noise is an $\mathbb{R}^m$-valued chaotic process given by multiple Wiener-Itô integrals of fixed order, allowing for non-Gaussian dynamics. Under mild smoothness assumptions on the coefficients and Hölder-type regularity of the noise, we establish existence and uniqueness of solutions.
